# Model card

One card per model. Replace each placeholder line with your own text.

## Intended use

What is the model for, and who uses it?

The intended use is that Example Ltd staff use this model to rank inbound support tickets for human agents.

## Limitations

Where does it perform badly, and what is out of scope?

It is weak on tickets shorter than five words and on languages other than English. Automated refusals are out of scope.

## Evaluation

Which metrics were measured, on which data, with what result?

Accuracy and F1 were measured on a held-out month of tickets; the results are in the evaluation report.

## Owner

Who maintains this card, and when was it last reviewed?

The Example Ltd service desk lead reviews this card each quarter.
